race.comment: ONE DAY AT A TIME (7) has raced exclusively in Melbourne this prep with mixed results. Was a month between runs when beaten just under three lengths in Saturday company two back then found the line with purpose to finish runner-up in a Caulfield Heath midweeker over this trip last start. The McEvoy team bring her here in peak fitness and she looks up to winning a race like this. OUI OUI MA CHERIE (9) is back after a five-month spell. Tackled stakes racing last prep with the best result a close fourth in the Morphettville Guineas over a mile. This is short of her best but while fresh she has the class to play a key role. GOLDEN CLOUD (2) came from well back for an emphatic victory over this distance at Murray Bridge recently. Flying this prep and this is well within reach. MOSTLY FOR SHOW (1) got going late when resuming over this distance at Murray Bridge a fortnight ago. Likely improver.
